package app

import (
	"net/http"
	"os"
	"os/exec"
	"time"

	"example.com/dep"
	"m/lib"
)

func Main() string {
	_ = exec.Command("true").Run()
	_ = http.MethodGet
	return os.Getenv("HOME") + time.Now().String() + dep.Name + lib.Name
}
